title: Two Models of Event Finality: Functional Alignment, Contestability, and Empirical Comparability on Polymarket and Kalshi
abstract: arXiv:2610.00183v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Event contracts reach economic finality through different institutional paths. Polymarket distinguishes oracle adjudication, adapter consumption, Conditional Tokens payout recording, technical redeemability, and optional holder redemption. Kalshi distinguishes venue determination, public finalization, lifecycle messages, and exact REST settlement fields. Resolved, settled, and finalized do not themselves define comparable endpoints. We define a mechanism-aware comparison certificate using functional roles rather than common labels. A scalar cross-venue duration is admissible only when payoff semantics, endpoint functions, calendar support, censoring, observation grades, and dependence units are jointly aligned. We separate exact paired, interval-qualified paired, and standardized unpaired estimands. translated_title: 事件终局性的两种模型：Polymarket 与 Kalshi 上的功能对齐、可争议性与经验可比性
translated_abstract: 事件合约通过不同的制度路径达到经济终局性。Polymarket 区分了预言机裁决、适配器消费、条件代币赔付记录、技术层面的可赎回性以及持有人可选赎回；Kalshi 则区分了交易场所判定、公开最终化、生命周期消息以及精确的 REST 结算字段。“已解决”、“已结算”与“已终局”这些状态本身并不构成可比较的终点。我们定义了一种机制感知的比较证书，依据功能角色而非通用标签进行判断。只有当赔付语义、终点功能、日历支持、删失处理、观测等级和依赖单位全部联合对齐时，标量形式的跨场所持续时间才是可采纳的。我们进一步区分了精确配对、区间限定配对和标准化非配对三类估计对象。Polymarket 的证据包含 108,638 个精确关联的条件、99,283 条协议赔付记录以及 92,158 笔任意金额的观测赎回（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种机制感知的事件合约终局性比较框架，以功能角色取代通用标签定义可比终点，并区分精确配对、区间限定配对与标准化非配对三类估计对象，从而实现对 Polymarket 与 Kalshi 跨场所结算时长的严格经验比较。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces a mechanism-aware comparison certificate for event contract finality that uses functional roles instead of common labels to define comparable endpoints, and separates exact paired, interval-qualified paired, and standardized unpaired estimands to enable rigorous empirical comparison of settlement durations across Polymarket and Kalshi.
